_om: Sauen in English (Sheepish, rusj.no/en/sheepish/): think like the flock, don't be the black sheep. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The questions are in data.en/sporsmal.json, written for the UK; answers are grouped by English plurals and articles (stammerEngelsk in spill.js). Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Send den rundt, og skriv etter tur: Pass it round and type in turn
På lapper eller hver sin mobil: On paper or on your own phones
Alle svarte det samme – alle får poeng!: Everyone gave the same answer – everyone scores!
The biggest groups were the same size.
Alle svarte noe forskjellig. For en sprø: Everyone said something different. What a wacky flock!
Svar det samme som flest mulig – men ikk: Give the same answer as as many others as you can – but don't be the only one who thinks differently.
Alle ser spørsmålet sammen, for eksempel: Everyone sees the question together – ‘A yellow fruit’, for example.
Send mobilen rundt og skriv etter tur –: Pass the phone round and type in turn – or choose ‘All at once’ and write on your own bits of paper.
Alle i den største gruppen får ett poeng: Everyone in the biggest group scores a point. If you're all alone, you get the black sheep.
Har du den svarte sauen, kan du ikke vin: While you hold the black sheep, you can't win. It moves on the next time one person stands alone.
Er de største gruppene like store, får i: If the biggest groups are the same size, nobody scores.
Én mobil: Etter avsløringen kan dere slå: One phone: after the reveal you can merge answers that mean the same, like ‘Lemon’ and ‘Yellow lemon’ – before the points are given out.
Alle samtidig: Mobilen teller ned {n} s: All at once: the phone counts down {n} s while everyone writes. On ‘show!’ everyone shows their answer, and you tap who's in the flock.
Den første som når målet uten den svarte: The first to reach the target without the black sheep wins. The target follows how many of you there are, and you can change it before you start.
Med tre spillere er sauen på beite: da g: With three players the sheep is out to pasture: it's all about following the flock.
Give the same answer as the others.
Er dere mange? Da går «Alle samtidig» my: A big group? ‘All at once’ is much quicker.
Med tre spillere er sauen på beite: inge: With three players the sheep is out to pasture: nobody gets the black sheep.
Alle skriver svarene sine selv – på en l: Everyone writes their own answers – on a scrap of paper or in the notes app on their own phone.
Denne mobilen viser spørsmålet og teller: This phone shows the question and counts down {n} s.
Alle skriver ett svar: det de tror de fl: Everyone writes one answer: what they think most people will say.
Alle viser svaret samtidig. Så trykker d: Everyone shows their answer at the same time. Then tap who's in the flock.
Skriv ett svar i hemmelighet – det du tr: Write one answer in secret – what you think the {andre} will say.
Alle svarer i hemmelighet. Svar det du t: Everyone answers in secret. Say what you think the {andre} will say!
De andre ser bort. Tenk som flokken: hva: Everyone else looks away. Think like the flock: what will most people say?
Samle dere rundt mobilen. Svarene vises: Gather round the phone. The answers appear one by one – the biggest group comes last.
The biggest groups are the same size.
Betyr to svar egentlig det samme? Trykk: Do two answers really mean the same? Tap both to merge them before the points are given out.
Hele flokken tenkte det samme!: The whole flock thought the same!
Trykk på svaret som betyr det samme – el: Tap the answer that means the same – or the same one again to undo.
Tap everyone in the biggest group.
Var akkurat én alene om svaret sitt? Try: Was exactly one player alone with their answer? Tap that player – otherwise ‘No’.
Whoever was alone gets the black sheep.
{navn} var den eneste som svarte «{svar}: {navn} was the only one to say ‘{svar}’ and gets the black sheep!
{navn} sto helt alene og får den svarte: {navn} was all alone and gets the black sheep!
{navn} står alene igjen og beholder den: {navn} is alone again and keeps the black sheep.
Sto alene {ganger} – og satt igjen med s: Alone {ganger} – and left holding the sheep
Satt igjen med sauen til slutt: Left holding the sheep at the end
Først til {n} poeng – uten den svarte sa: First to {n} points – without the black sheep.
The answer needs letters or numbers.
Valgt. Trykk på svaret som betyr det sam: Selected. Tap the answer that means the same, or the same one again to undo.
Dere går til kåringen med stillingen så: You'll go to the results with the scores so far.
